author: HarryCochran
quote: Awful. The story line is awful. The endings, all of them, are awful. Who wants to play a game where they spend hours doing chores when the people playing this dont even take care of their own real life responsibilities. The characters have the personalities of wet blankets and its abysmal to deal with through the entire game. It makes me sick that I even bought GTA6. Thank you for destroying everything about a game that people have held so high for almost 30 years. A game that has paved the way over the years for an almost limitless world of chaotic gaming. Bravo.
